This infrastructure is not a hack, but a deliberate choice to own your payment and delivery pipeline, just like the founders of COREMERCH did in Zimbabwe.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current payment infrastructure is broken for digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Platforms like Gumroad and Stripe are either unavailable or severely restricted, leaving creators to deal with payout delays, high fees, and limited conversion options. That's why a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is needed – one that lets creators receive USDT payments directly, without relying on any platform. This infrastructure uses NOWPayments, a payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, with fees as low as $0.10 per transaction.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying this infrastructure, you'll need a few essential tools: a web hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic system like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery platform like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Additionally, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, which offers a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This setup will take around 2-3 hours, depending on your technical expertise.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, follow these steps: first, host your digital products on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; second, create a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic and payment processing; third, configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage; fourth, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery; and fifth, integrate NOWPayments for automatic USDT payment verification. By following these steps, you'll have a seamless payment and delivery pipeline that takes care of conversions, fees, and storage for you.
You can process USDT payments in mere seconds with NOWPayments, compared to PayPal's days or weeks.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. To process your first transaction, simply upload your digital products to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure your NOWPayments account, and start selling. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook will automatically fire, verifying the payment on-chain and sending a confirmation to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script. From there, you can deliver your digital products to your customers via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is straightforward. As your sales grow, simply add more products to your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages store, update your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script to handle the increased load, and configure your Supabase or Google Sheets to store more orders. With NOWPayments handling automatic USDT payment verification, you can focus on growing your business without worrying about payment and delivery complexities.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Using NOWPayments with your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure can save you up to 90% on fees compared to traditional payment processors.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, follow these concrete steps: set up a web hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; create a backend logic system like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script; configure an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets; set up a file delivery platform like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; integrate NOWPayments for automatic USDT payment verification; and test your infrastructure to ensure seamless payment and delivery. Shop for the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is NOWPayments and how does it work?

NOWPayments is a payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, with fees as low as $0.10 per transaction. It uses webhooks to verify payments on-chain and send confirmations to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script.
Can I use NOWPayments with other digital products beyond ebooks?

Yes, NOWPayments supports a wide range of digital products, including courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Simply integrate it with your existing infrastructure and start selling.
What is the difference between Tron and Solana for USDT payments?

Tron and Solana offer similar fee structures for USDT payments, with Tron averaging around $0.10 per transaction and Solana averaging fractions of a cent per transaction. Choose the one that suits your business needs.
How do I configure my NOWPayments account for automatic USDT payment verification?

To configure your NOWPayments account, simply log in to your dashboard, enable automatic on-chain verification, and set up webhooks to send confirmations to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script.
What happens if I encounter any issues with my sovereign digital commerce infrastructure?
If you encounter any issues, simply refer to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) documentation or reach out to the COREMERCH support team for assistance.
